page_title: SWI 1-0 CAM | Switzerland v Cameroon 24/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Facundo Tello couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Georges-Kevin N'Koudou (Cameroon) and blew his whistle.
90+6' Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) works the corner short.

90+6' Haris Seferovic (Switzerland) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Switzerland can continue in their attacking effort.
90+3' Fabian Rieder (Switzerland) takes a short corner kick.
90+2' The attendance is 39089.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.

86' The referee blows his whistle as Nicolas Moumi Ngamaleu (Cameroon) was too aggressive in his challenge.
83' Manuel Akanji (Switzerland) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Facundo Tello had an easy-decision to make.

68' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
67' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

66' Andre Onana pulls off a great save to deny Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! The linesman points to the corner flag, Switzerland are going to take it.

66' Andre Zambo Anguissa (Cameroon) latches on to a cross from the free kick and attempts to direct a bullet header into the middle of the goal. Yann Sommer is alert, though, and makes a decent save to deny him.
65' Remo Freuler (Switzerland) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
64' Facundo Tello shows a yellow card to Nico Elvedi (Switzerland) for his blatant foul.
63' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
63' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
61' A lofted cross from Collins Fai (Cameroon) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
61' Cameroon players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
58' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
58' Bryan Mbeumo (Cameroon) whips in a cross from the corner, but Yann Sommer is well positioned and punches the ball away.
57' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Cameroon) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save.

48' 1 - 0 Goal! Xherdan Shaqiri plays a pass to the feet of Breel Embolo (Switzerland), and he shoots into the back of the net from inside the box. It's 1:0.

45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+3' Karl Toko Ekambi (Cameroon) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
45+3' Djibril Sow (Switzerland) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Facundo Tello blows for a foul.

45+1' Manuel Akanji (Switzerland) watches the corner all the way, but places his header a whisker wide of the left post from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cameroon.
45+1' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

35' Collins Fai (Cameroon) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

34' Xherdan Shaqiri (Switzerland) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cameroon.
33' Silvan Widmer (Switzerland) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
32' A spell of possession for Cameroon in an attempt to control the game.
30' Cameroon take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
30' Martin Hongla (Cameroon) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
29' A cross from Ricardo Rodriguez (Switzerland) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
29' Dangerous play by Collins Fai (Cameroon). Facundo Tello blows his whistle for a foul.
27' The ball is cleared after Silvan Widmer (Switzerland) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

26' Collins Fai (Cameroon) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Switzerland will have a goal kick.
24' The corner by Bryan Mbeumo (Cameroon) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
24' Nouhou Tolo (Cameroon) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
22' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
22' Nouhou Tolo (Cameroon) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Facundo Tello no option but to blow his whistle.
21' Rough tackle by Andre Zambo Anguissa (Cameroon). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
21' The ball possession at the moment is 59:41.

19' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ricardo Rodriguez (Switzerland).
16' Xherdan Shaqiri (Switzerland) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
14' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Cameroon) is flagged for offside.
13' Breel Embolo (Switzerland) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

12' Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cameroon.
10' Karl Toko Ekambi (Cameroon) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
10' Yann Sommer pulls off a great save to deny Bryan Mbeumo (Cameroon), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
9' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
8' Silvan Widmer (Switzerland) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is behind the touchline and Switzerland will take a throw-in.
7' Martin Hongla (Cameroon) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
7' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cameroon, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
6' Remo Freuler (Switzerland) makes a strong challenge and Facundo Tello blows for a foul.
5' Xherdan Shaqiri (Switzerland) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
4' Xherdan Shaqiri (Switzerland) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
2' Xherdan Shaqiri (Switzerland) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
2' Djibril Sow (Switzerland) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Switzerland have been awarded a corner kick.
